summary: RETEST after fix to apply_asin_mapping (line_key no longer rewritten). All 9 iteration-4 tests pass. All 10 iteration-3 regression tests pass. Idempotency bug is fully fixed: amazon_po.xls re-upload after applying a mapping returns inserted=0 and total Amazon orders stay at exactly 6,580. /api/orders?sku=<merchant_sku> finds remapped orders with asin field preserved and line_key matching ::B[0-9A-Z]{9}. Feature also verified end-to-end with a fresh ASIN (B0DJMM6J4L): first upload reported orders_remapped=14, second idempotent upload reported orders_remapped=0. Cost parser still works on both cost_v2.xlsx and cost_prod.xlsx.

minor.issue: orders_remapped is correctly 0 on re-upload of an already-applied mapping (idempotent). Test was tightened to only enforce >=1 when inserted=1 (fresh mapping).
No DELETE endpoint exposed — to clean up a single mapping (e.g. in tests) the DB must be touched directly. Consider exposing an admin DELETE.
(Carry-over from iter 4) Still no 'source' query filter — must use marketplaces='Amazon Vendor' to count Amazon PO orders.

action_items: (Optional) Add DELETE /api/asin-mappings/{asin} for clean management/test teardown.
(Carry-over) Add 'source' query param to GET /api/orders for filtering by amazon_po / channelengine / beezup.
(Carry-over from iter 3/4) server.py is 1,500 lines — split into routers/parsers modules.
(Carry-over from iter 3) PUT /api/cost-constants has no admin-role check.
(Carry-over from iter 4) POST /api/uploads/asin-mapping has no admin-role check — any authenticated user can rewrite the entire ASIN mapping.
critical_code_review_comments: apply_asin_mapping (server.py:413-423) now correctly updates only sku, NEVER line_key — matches the invariant in _remap_amazon_orders' docstring. Bug fix is clean.
_remap_amazon_orders already uses bulk_write batches of 500 — good (iter-4 review comment is resolved).
Still no DELETE/PATCH for individual asin_mappings — only bulk upload via CSV/XLSX.
server.py reached 1,500 lines — split into routers/uploads.py, routers/asin.py, parsers/*.py becomes increasingly urgent.

asin_mappings collection has unique index on 'asin' — good. db.orders.asin still un-indexed; remap scan iterates source='amazon_po' (~6,580 rows) — acceptable for current size but should be indexed if orders grow.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iteration4.py (relaxed test_upload_asin_mapping_inserts_and_remaps to be tolerant of pre-existing mapping state: enforces orders_remapped>=1 only when inserted=1)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Idempotency bug is FIXED and verified. Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_iteration4.py test_iteration3.py -v → 19/19 should pass. DB state at end of this session: 6,580 Amazon orders, 3 leftover asin_mappings from iter4 (harmless — orders already remapped). If a future test needs to verify orders_remapped>=1 on a fresh ASIN, pick one NOT in {B00PB8WM4S, B0CT5QL1DZ, B07PCPH33X} (e.g. iterate /api/orders?marketplaces=Amazon Vendor and find an order where sku==asin).
rca of the issue: Already resolved in iter 5. The line_key rewrite at server.py:422 was deleted; line_key now stays {po_number}::{ASIN} regardless of mapping. Re-uploads of amazon_po.xls are now fully idempotent (inserted=0, updated may be 0 if no field changed). The duplicates that existed at end of iter-4 (6,614 vs 6,580) were cleaned by the main agent before this retest — confirmed via /api/orders?marketplaces=Amazon Vendor total=6580.
